description: This Java source file defines a benchmark test class `Test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto` that implements the `MapToDittoProtocolScenario` interface. It contains a Java class responsible for constructing and mapping JSON payloads into a Ditto protocol message using JavaScript code embedded as a string. The class initializes an external message with unique correlation ID and provides methods to retrieve a configured JavaScript message mapper and the external message.

classes.name: Test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A Java class implementing a specific protocol scenario for testing JSON payload construction and mapping to Ditto protocol messages, using embedded JavaScript code for message transformation.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a JavaScript message mapper instance with embedded mapping script.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the externally constructed message instance with correlation ID and headers.
